verdict.rationale: Orrick's Tech Studio offers a forms library ('Simplify the paperwork') and a Global Employment & Equity Compensation practice that positions itself as a one-stop shop for HR legal issues, and community comments confirm Orrick's downloadable document sets (used for company formation) are considered comprehensive. However, none of the evidence names specific offer-letter, employment-agreement, or invention-assignment/confidentiality-agreement templates as part of a documented hiring practice. Missing for 10: explicit mention of offer letter templates, employment agreement templates, or IP/confidentiality assignment forms within Tech Studio's 50+ forms, and any first-hand account of using them for hiring paperwork specifically.
